item.title: Over €2 million worth of cannabis seized at Dublin Airport
item.description: Herbal cannabis worth more than €2 million has been seized at Dublin Airport. Revenue officers discovered 107 kilos of the drug concealed in boxes during a routine operation yesterday. The boxes were labelled ‘linen bedding’, had originated in the US, and were destined for an address in Northern Ireland. Investigations are ongoing.
